none: PAS LIN-49FA33: Roman silver TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver TOT ring, Henig type XI. The bezel is rectangular and bears the letters TOT, which is an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Toutatis or Totatis. The inscription is set within a border comprised of punched opposed chevrons. This ring is number 92 in Daubney's catalogue
